name: Verification
description: Keep bots out: new members solve a captcha before they get access to the server.

members.help: Members on this list get the role back by pressing Verify, without a captcha.
members.searchHelp: Search by the start of a name or a user ID. Names only find people who are on the server.
members.addHelp: With Developer Mode on, right click a member in Discord and choose Copy User ID. Members on the server get the role straight away.
members.added: {name} is verified and got the role.
members.addedLater: {name} is on the list. They get the role by pressing Verify after joining.
members.roleProblem: The role cannot be given right now: {error}
members.removeBody: In captcha mode they will have to solve a captcha again next time they press Verify.
members.removeBodyRole: In captcha mode they will have to solve a captcha again next time they press Verify. Do you also want to take away the verified role?
members.removedRole: {name} was removed from the list and lost the role.

defaults.title: Verify to enter {server}
defaults.descriptionCaptcha: Click the button below and type the code from the picture. It takes a few seconds and keeps bots out of {server}.
defaults.descriptionButton: Click the button below to confirm you are a real person and unlock the rest of {server}.

form.rules: Captcha codes expire after {minutes} minutes. Wrong answers are counted per member for {window} minutes, so a new picture does not reset them.
form.enabledHelp: ShifuBot posts a panel with a Verify button in the channel below.
form.modeCaptchaHelp: Members type a code from a picture. Stops automated accounts.
form.modeButtonHelp: One click. Fast, but only stops the simplest bots.
form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.
form.minAccountAgeHelp: Accounts younger than this cannot verify. Fresh accounts are a common sign of raids. 0 turns it off.
form.returningNote: Members who verified before get the role back by pressing the button, without another captcha. The same goes if they rejoin or a moderator removes the role.
form.lockHint: Verification only gives a role. To keep unverified members out, let only the verified role see your channels, and let everyone see the panel channel.
form.maxAttemptsHelp: Wrong answers a member may give before the action below runs.

failActionHelp.retry: Nothing happens. The member can ask for a new picture right away.
failActionHelp.timeout: The member cannot chat or verify until the timeout ends. Needs the Timeout Members permission.
failActionHelp.kick: The member is removed but can rejoin with an invite. Needs the Kick Members permission.
failActionHelp.ban: The member is banned until an admin lifts it. Needs the Ban Members permission.

form.failActionWarning: Real people mistype too. A timeout is usually enough; kick or ban mostly makes sense during a raid.
form.captchaOnly: Tries and actions apply only to the captcha method.

status.noChannel: Pick a channel for the panel.
status.noRole: Pick the role verified members get.
status.channelMissing: The selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.missingPermissions: ShifuBot is missing permissions in this channel: {permissions}.
status.panelMissing: The panel is not posted yet. Save, or post it again below.

panel.failed: Settings saved, but the panel could not be updated: {error}
panel.help: Use this if someone deleted the panel message.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: The panel exactly as Discord will show it.
preview.captchaHint: A new random code every time. Only the member who clicked sees it.

setup.title: Verification
setup.description: Keep bots out with a captcha. Fine tune texts and protection later on the Verification page.
setup.channelRequired: Pick a channel, or turn verification off for now.
setup.roleRequired: Pick the role verified members get.

replies.disabled: Verification is turned off on this server.
replies.notConfigured: Verification is not set up correctly. Please tell a server admin.
replies.restored: You verified before, so here is your role again.
replies.tooYoung: Your Discord account is too new to verify here. Accounts must be at least {days} days old.
replies.captchaBody:
Type the {length} characters from the picture. Click **Enter code** to answer.
The code expires in {minutes} minutes. Tries left: {attempts}.
replies.expired: Your code expired or was used up. Click **Verify** on the panel again.
replies.wrong: That code is not right. Tries left: {left}.
replies.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong tries. Click **Verify** on the panel to get a new picture.
replies.roleFailed: You solved it, but ShifuBot could not give you the role. Please tell a server admin.
replies.slowDown: Slow down a little. Try again in a minute.
replies.failedTimeout: Too many wrong tries. You are timed out for {minutes} minutes. Try again after that.
replies.failedKick: Too many wrong tries. You will be removed from the server. You can rejoin and try again.
replies.failedBan: Too many wrong tries. You will be banned from the server.
replies.timedOut: You are timed out. You can verify again {time}.

errors.missing_permissions: missing permissions in the panel channel
errors.role_managed: the role is managed by an integration and cannot be given
errors.no_manage_roles: ShifuBot is missing the Manage Roles permission
errors.role_too_high: the role is above ShifuBot's highest role. Drag ShifuBot's role above it in Server Settings → Roles
errors.role_failed: Discord refused to give the role
errors.role_remove_failed: Discord refused to take the role
errors.already_verified: This member is already on the list
errors.unknown_user: There is no Discord user with this ID
errors.fail_action_failed: ShifuBot could not punish a member who failed the captcha: it is missing the permission, or the member's role is above ShifuBot's
